checks.label: not up two days in a row

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=32 breakdowns=10 bursts_in_base=2 giveback=3.47 tightness=0.89 base_volume_vs_leg=0.8 base_volume_vs_avg=0.96
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 32 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 10 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 3.47 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -11.3% vs its 20-SMA, -32.1% over 20 sessions
gain of 22.66% is 15% or more: the worst cell in the only event study, a 36% win rate and -9.3% at 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The chart shows OKLO in a persistent multi-month downtrend from ~$50 to ~$20, and the shaded base region spanning 32 sessions is not a consolidation but a declining staircase with 10 recorded 4% breakdowns and a giveback of 3.47x the prior leg — the base is visibly a downtrend with bounces, not an orderly tight consolidation. The RE check also fails (burst bar range is only 0.73x the prior 5-bar maximum), meaning the signal bar itself is not a genuine range expansion. Together, a structurally broken base and a failed RE make this plan wrong.
claude.key_risk: The stock is in a confirmed downtrend with massive overhead supply from months of distribution above current price, and the 22.66% gain on a prior-day drop of 13.2% looks like a dead-cat bounce rather than a momentum burst.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps below the prior close or shows any weakness in the first 30 minutes, as the downtrend context makes any failed follow-through immediately dangerous.
